description_short: Politecnico di Milano's Merit Based International Scholarships for academic year 2027-2028 are awarded to applicants to its English-taught Master's programmes. All awards include a tuition fee waiver; the scholarship form is submitted through Politecnico di Milano Online Services by 15 December 2026.
